summary_en: 300,000 shares (3.98% of S/O), ¥150M ceiling, open-market purchase on TSE via regulated trading, Aug 12 2026–Jun 30 2027. Acquired shares to be cancelled to enhance capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice of Decision on Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: Riskmonster announced a buyback program on 10 August 2026. The company is authorized to acquire up to 300,000 treasury shares (3.98% of the 7,537,154 shares outstanding excluding treasury) for a maximum of ¥150M via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange's regulated trading segment. The acquisition window runs from 12 August 2026 through 30 June 2027, aligned with the annual shareholder meeting schedule, with flexibility to adjust timing based on market conditions and stock price. Acquired shares will be cancelled as the base policy to enhance capital efficiency and strengthen shareholder returns. Financing will come from retained earnings while maintaining financial soundness.
